parameters.name: X-Client-Type
parameters.description: What kind of client this is. Absent or unknown means web. Asks for the refresh token in the response body instead of a cookie; it is not proof, and a request that looks like a web page gets cookies whatever it says. Native clients must also send X-Device-Id and a User-Agent, and get no cookies.

parameters.name: X-Device-Id
parameters.description: The client install's random id, generated once and kept. A new sign-in replaces the sessions of the same install.

parameters.name: X-Device-Name
parameters.description: Native clients: a name for the device in its owner's sessions list, as percent-encoded UTF-8. Sanitized and capped by the server.

post.summary:
Sign in with browser (desktop app), step 1: the user, signed in in the
browser, confirmed signing in the desktop app as themselves. Mints a
single-use code bound to the app's PKCE challenge; the browser hands it
to the app (a loopback redirect), which redeems it at
POST /auth/desktop/token.

Only with the access token in the Authorization header, which a page
has to read from the app's memory: never with the cookie alone, so
another site can't approve a grant through a cross-site request.

post.summary:
Sign in with browser (desktop app), step 2: the app redeems the code
with its PKCE verifier for a session of its own (this request's device).
Every failure (unknown, expired or used code, wrong verifier, the
approving session ended) answers the same 401; the code is spent either
way.

SessionTerminatedReason.description:
Why the server ended the session, right before it disconnects the socket.
TOKEN_EXPIRED: a refreshed token is enough to reconnect. LOGGED_OUT,
SESSION_REVOKED, PASSWORD_CHANGED: refreshing fails unless the client holds
another valid session. ACCOUNT_BANNED, ACCOUNT_DELETED: the account can no
longer sign in.

reason.description:
Why the server ended the session, right before it disconnects the socket.
TOKEN_EXPIRED: a refreshed token is enough to reconnect. LOGGED_OUT,
SESSION_REVOKED, PASSWORD_CHANGED: refreshing fails unless the client holds
another valid session. ACCOUNT_BANNED, ACCOUNT_DELETED: the account can no
longer sign in.
